sentences.en: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.
sentences.zh: 政府将采取强制措施来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Incidents broke out between the antigovernment protestors and law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 反政府抗议者与执法人员之间发生了冲突。

sentences.en: The FBI is the world's most powerful law enforcement agency.
sentences.zh: FBI 是世界上最强大的执法机构。

senses.zh: 执行，实施；强制执行；（法律、规则等的）生效

collocations.en: strict enforcement of a new law
